title: LoreFountain Workspace Configuration
description: Project-owned configuration for the LoreFountain VS Code extension. Lives at the workspace root as lorefountain.config.json.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference, for editors/tools that resolve it independently of VS Code's own schema association.

folders.description: Workspace-relative folder names. Any field left unset uses its documented default.

world.description: Folder containing entity .md files (characters, locations, factions, objects, concepts, arcs), plus the glossary/, timeline/, and notes/ subfolders.

imports.description: Drop-zone folder for existing source docs/bibles to migrate via the 'Migrate Existing Lore' command.

assets.description: Folder for production assets and their manifests (e.g. assets/manifests/audio.json, mapping SFX/MUSIC/AMB cue tags to the licensed/generated files that fulfill them). A peer of world/, not a subfolder of it.

hiddenCategories.description: World-tree category ids to hide from the sidebar (e.g. a project with no Factions or Arcs can hide those sections without deleting anything).

comic.description: Comic-script settings (scripts with PAGE: and PANEL: lines). The word-budget numbers are guidance from writers' guides and creator handbooks, not standards; they only ever produce informational notes.

preset.description: The word-budget preset this project starts from. Overrides the user-level setting lorefountain.comic.defaultPreset. western: up to 9 panels per page, 3 balloons per panel, 25 words per balloon, 35 words per panel. manga: like western but up to 8 panels per page. european: no panels-per-page check. webtoon: no panels-per-page check (a vertical scroll has no pages). custom: no built-in limits; only comic.limits apply.
preset.markdownDescription:
The word-budget preset this project starts from. Overrides the user-level setting `lorefountain.comic.defaultPreset`.

- `western`: up to 9 panels per page, 3 balloons per panel, 25 words per balloon, 35 words per panel
- `manga`: like western, but up to 8 panels per page
- `european`: no panels-per-page check
- `webtoon`: no panels-per-page check (a vertical scroll has no pages)
- `custom`: no built-in limits; only `comic.limits` apply

limits.description: Per-limit overrides of the preset. Each is a whole number of at least 1, or null to switch that note off.

maxPanelsPerPage.description: A page with more numbered panels than this is noted (many-panels). null: not checked.

maxBalloonsPerPanel.description: A panel with more balloons than this is noted (many-balloons). null: not checked.

maxWordsPerBalloon.description: A balloon with more words than this is noted (long-balloon). null: not checked.

maxWordsPerPanel.description: A panel whose balloons and captions hold more words than this is noted (long-panel-dialogue). Sound effects are not counted. null: not checked.

sfxAsCue.description: When false (the default), an SFX: line inside a comic panel is lettering only: it is not written to the .cues.json audio cue sidecar and is not checked against audio.json. Set true for a narrated or motion comic where an effect is both lettered and heard. MUSIC: and AMB: are always audio cues.
